correctness.rationale: Under coordinate squaring the equation is a cubic. In coordinates u=a-c, v=b-c, c its equation has the form c A_2(u,v)+B_3(u,v), with squarefree tangent cone A_2 and resultant nonzero in the permitted range. The homogeneous forms have no common root also at v=0; the primitive linear equation in c proves irreducibility and projection gives rational normalization. The node accounts for its whole arithmetic genus. On its normalization a/c=D/B and b/c=C/B (C=B-A and here D=B-rA); their parity patterns at the disjoint simple roots of D, C and B are respectively (1,0), (0,1), (1,1), with no branch at infinity. This proves square-class independence, connectedness and nine tame branch points, giving 2g-2=-8+18. The squaring map is étale off the axes and takes the cubic node to four ordinary nodes upstairs by inverse image. At a simple axis intersection the local pullback is adjoining the square root of a uniformizer and the other coordinate is a unit, so the plane model is smooth there. There is no plane component contained in an axis. The three intermediate double covers are branched at six points each, and cyclic coordinate permutation identifies them. On differentials their pullbacks are the three nontrivial character summands since the full quotient has genus zero and 4 is invertible, so the sum of their Jacobian pullbacks is an isogeny. Independent polynomial checks verify the coefficient indices 4,3,9,8 and determinant t^8 in characteristic five. The fifth-root twist in the Cartier action does not change invertibility; hence the factors have 5-rank two and their product has rank six. At t=0 the three cubic polynomials have distinct triple roots, leaving just three tame branch points and genus zero. If t^2=2 the common A_2 and B_3 linear factor makes the base cubic reducible and the squaring pullback reducible. The point at infinity is a union of lines. Thus these exceptions do not hide another smooth normalized genus-six member.
residual_risks: The replay checks polynomial identities only; the geometric proof handles the arbitrary algebraically closed field and all allowed parameters.
The stated determinant is for the coefficient-form matrix in the given coordinate, not an invariant scalar independent of bases and conventions.

value.rationale: This is a geometric ordinarity classification of every permitted member of a canonical genus-six pencil in an exceptional characteristic, not a check over four field elements or a generic nonvanishing result. It rules out any interior nonordinary parameter, and the explicit low-genus isogeny factors explain and make usable the uniform arithmetic statement.
residual_risks: No claim about full zeta functions or descent over arbitrary nonclosed fields follows from the reviewed statement.
